record.paper_title: Noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations: some results and open problems
record.context_brief: adiabatic Weyl formula for arbitrary foliations
record.original_question: Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold, with codimension q, tangential Laplacian Delta_F, transverse Laplacian Delta_H, linearized foliation F_N on the conormal bundle N^*F, induced metric function g_N on N^*F, and noncommutative trace tr_{F_N}. Does the adiabatic asymptotic formula tr f(Delta_F + h^2 Delta_H) = (2 pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(Delta_{F_N} + g_N) + o(h^{-q}) hold as h -> 0 for every compactly supported smooth function f?

evidence.quote: Observe that the formula (10) makes sense for an arbitrary, not necessarily Riemannian, foliation. Therefore, it is quite reasonable to conjecture that it holds in such generality.

Conjecture 3.15. Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold. In the above notation, for any function f in C_c^infinity(R), the asymptotic formula holds: tr f(Delta_F + h^2 Delta_H) = (2pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(Delta_{F_N} + g_N) + o(h^{-q}), h -> 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a compact Riemannian manifold and let $F$ be a (not necessarily Riemannian) smooth foliation on $M$ of codimension $q$. Decompose $TM = TF \oplus H$, where $TF$ is the tangent bundle to the leaves and $H$ is the orthogonal complement. Let $\Delta_F$ denote the tangential (leafwise) Laplacian acting on $L^2(M)$ and let $\Delta_H$ denote the transverse Laplacian associated with the splitting. 

Let $N^*F \subset T^*M$ be the conormal bundle of $F$, and let $F_N$ be the linearized foliation on $N^*F$ (the foliation whose leaves are obtained by lifting the leaves of $F$ via the linearized holonomy on $N^*F$). The metric $g$ induces a fiberwise quadratic function $g_N : N^*F \to \mathbb{R}$, namely $g_N(\xi) = |\xi|_{g^*}^2$, and a tangential Laplacian $\Delta_{F_N}$ for the foliation $F_N$. Let $\mathrm{tr}_{F_N}$ denote the canonical (noncommutative) trace on the von Neumann algebra of the foliation $F_N$.

For $h>0$, consider the self-adjoint operator $\Delta_F + h^2 \Delta_H$ on $L^2(M)$. 

Question: Is it true that for every $f \in C_c^{\infty}(\mathbb{R})$ one has the adiabatic asymptotic
$$\mathrm{tr}\, f(\Delta_F + h^2 \Delta_H) = (2\pi)^{-q} h^{-q}\, \mathrm{tr}_{F_N} f(\Delta_{F_N} + g_N) + o(h^{-q}), \quad h \to 0^+\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is stated as a conjecture extending the Riemannian-foliation case (where the adiabatic Weyl formula is known via work of Kordyukov and Álvarez López) to arbitrary foliations. Web searches turn up no proof of this extension; recent surveys on noncommutative geometry and semiclassical spectral asymptotics on foliations still discuss it as a conjecture. No resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Noncommutative Geometry, Spectral Asymptotics, and Semiclassical Analysis
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys adiabatic spectral asymptotics on foliations and related semiclassical results; the arbitrary-foliation Weyl asymptotic is treated as a conjectural extension.
status_evidence.claim: No proof of the arbitrary-foliation adiabatic Weyl formula is reported; it is discussed at the conjectural level.

status_evidence.title: Adiabatic limits and spectral sequences for Riemannian foliations
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes adiabatic spectral asymptotics in the Riemannian foliation setting.
status_evidence.claim: The result is established for Riemannian foliations, not for arbitrary foliations.
